**Introduction to Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd.**

Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. is a distinguished chemical enterprise headquartered at No. 136, Qingchun Road, Hangzhou, in the vibrant Zhejiang Province of China. Strategically located in one of the country's most dynamic economic hubs, the company has established itself as a prominent player in the chemical and new materials industry, serving both domestic and international markets with innovative, high-quality solutions.

Specializing in the research, development, production, and distribution of advanced chemical products and new materials, Runhe Chemical is committed to delivering reliable performance across a diverse range of applications. The company's product portfolio encompasses specialty silicones, organosilicon intermediates, silane coupling agents, and other fine chemical materials that are widely utilized in industries such as electronics, automotive, construction, textiles, personal care, coatings, and adhesives. Through continuous investment in research and development, Runhe Chemical strives to push the boundaries of material science and offer customers customized solutions that meet evolving market demands.

Guided by a philosophy of innovation, integrity, and sustainability, Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. integrates green manufacturing practices and stringent quality control systems throughout its operations. Backed by a team of skilled professionals, modern production facilities, and a robust global distribution network, the company has earned a strong reputation for technical expertise and dependable service. As it continues to grow, Runhe Chemical remains dedicated to advancing the chemical industry while contributing to the sustainable development of society and supporting its partners' long-term success worldwide.
